recommendations.finding: Conversion is the one fragile check: subscribers per 1,000 views read 0.6 against a usual 2.9. On E8, DesignerTom gained 26 subscribers (9.3 per 1,000 views) while Dive Club gained 12 (3.6 per 1,000).
recommendations.action: Say a spoken subscribe ask twice on each stream this week: once at the live peak and once in the close. Log Dive Club and DesignerTom sign-ups separately to test whether E8's DesignerTom pull repeats.

recommendations.finding: Finished episodes keep losing viewers early. Around minute 11, E4 lost 4.6 of every 100 and E5 lost 5.4. E6 lost 4.7 around minute 15. Those spots follow catch-up talk and a first showpiece.
recommendations.action: Test moving the first guest work or showpiece into the opening ten minutes and cutting the pre-show banter. Compare early exits on the next episode with these three.

recommendations.finding: E9 drew the biggest live crowd: peak 133, average 109, and viewers stayed 14.2 minutes. At minute 83 the soundboard bit added 2.2 viewers of every 100, while the audience was already growing.
recommendations.action: Plan one interactive bit per episode, such as a soundboard reveal or a live chat prompt, at a fixed point past the halfway mark. Test whether it holds viewers late, and protect the live strength.

recommendations.finding: Some surfaces bring almost nothing: end screens gave 14 views (0 share) and playlists just 0.5 share of YouTube views. Existing subscribers supply 71% of views, so the show leans on people who already know it.
recommendations.action: Add an end screen pointing to the newest episode on both channels. Group the best finished episodes into one playlist and pin it. Check the next two episodes to see whether either surface picks up.

recommendations.finding: On E6, LinkedIn viewers said they couldn't hear the caller. That stream's LinkedIn chat held 8 messages from 3 people. The sentiment balance reads 90 against a usual 100.
recommendations.action: Run a sound check with every caller and guest before going live. Keep a host watching the LinkedIn chat for audio complaints, and fix levels within the first minutes.

knownBreaks.note: Restream's per-channel live reporting changed from E5: the X destinations began reporting live viewers, and the unique-viewer totals before and after are not like for like (E1–E4 counted YouTube only).

definitions: typical
the middle value from the usable peers among the eight episodes before the one being read: promo outliers out, peers without the needed kind of reading out, three or nothing.
same age
a value taken from the daily snapshot at the same days-since-premiere as the episode under test — the only honest way to compare a young episode with older ones.
as the earlier episodes stand now
a comparison made with the earlier episodes' current (matured, at least twenty-one days) values because no same-age history exists yet; the note says so.
clean
not a promo outlier, not tracked late, with the needed daily readings.
promo outlier

an episode whose YouTube views, X plays, or X reach exceed twice the same-age typical of the nearby episodes; provisional before day twenty-one, settled after. Its own lift is shown but scores nothing (qualified); it is left out of every typical.
carried
a show-health measure read from an older, finished episode because the newest is too young; it counts at half weight and names the episode it read.
swing and bands

a measure's swing is the middle distance of its peers from their typical, as a share of the typical; a check's bands use half the middle swing of its measures either side of fifty, never narrower than five points nor wider than fifteen; the state word (healthy / steady / fragile) follows the bands.
launch word

an episode's first-week standing in one word — strong, typical, or soft — from YouTube views at day seven (or the earliest reading, or the current age while under a week, marked provisional) against the other episodes at that age, promo outliers out, three or nothing.
first week vs launch reading

a first week needs a clean seven-day record and feeds the growth slope; a launch reading is the same-age standing available from the first day and can exist where a first week cannot (an episode tracked late).
episode health
a frozen zero-to-hundred read written once the episode is twenty-one days old, comparing it with the episodes that aired before it; fifty is typical; two episodes' scores are not on one baseline.
show health

a daily read of the newest episode at its age against the show's usual levels — seven checks, each built from its available measures; the words come from a model or the fixed fallback and cite these facts.
direction

each durable measure's change per episode (Theil–Sen slope) over the last five clean episodes; a word needs four; building above plus five percent, softening below minus five; the overall word is single only when every check agrees, otherwise mixed.
outlook

where the last three clean first weeks landed (lowest, highest, typical) with their direction — a description of what happened, never a bound on what will; the cool-off is the newest episode's growth over its last two days.
hold rate
the live audience over the last ten minutes of the session as a share of the peak.
discovery share
the share of an episode's YouTube views that YouTube itself brought — search, suggested videos, Shorts, browse.
total views
YouTube views plus resolved X broadcast plays; native tweet and teaser-video plays are excluded. X reach (impressions on the announce posts) is exposure and is never added in.
X reach

impressions on the hosts' announce posts — the X posts that carry the episode's broadcast. Promo posts are counted separately and never added in. A reading from before 2026-09-04 that blends an announce and a promo post on one account cannot be split and is left out.
promo post

an X post about an episode that does not carry its broadcast (a teaser, a clip, a link to the YouTube upload). Its impressions are shown beside X reach, never compared and never added to reach or views. Promo posts were not searched for before E6, so an episode with none registered has no promo figure, not a zero.
